candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, which order propagates as 502 to gateway /v1/checkout; gateway checkout 502s are downstream failures originating at payment, not a gateway fault.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-service logs, metrics or traces are present; the 503 root cause inside payment is unobserved.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failure follows a payment 503 on /v1/authorizations, surfaced as order 502 and gateway 502; inventory/redis calls succeed. Gateway itself is healthy (readyz 200). Bounded candidate is downstream payment failure; payment-side evidence is still required to confirm the underlying fault.
